summary: The elapsed computation is reversed (start - now), so response.elapsed is always negative.

findings.explanation: `elapsed = self._start - time.perf_counter()` yields a negative number (start is earlier than now), so Response.elapsed becomes a negative timedelta; elapsed is a public attribute and may break timing logic and tests that assert elapsed >= 0.
Same reversed subtraction in BoundAsyncStream.aclose; async responses also get negative elapsed.
